_note: The 2D layer's look (crates/core/src/ui2d/theme.rs). Colours are 0-255. fonts: CSS families, a weight, and the glyph advance in percent of the size (the core lays labels out by it). fishboy: the screen's virtual canvas, the first-person field of view in degrees, the screen's share of the view (percent of width or height, whichever binds), and how long raising it takes. radar: the map picture in blocks of block_mm (2.5 m: the person's 80% fidelity), its colours, the fine grid, range rings, the ping's sweep band and the players' radar colours. tiers: each tier's colour and frame shape (double, notched, dashed, plain). standin: the plain lake drawn behind the Fish-Boy until the world renderer lands.

mono.family: ui-monospace, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
